name: Malaysian Relief Agency
summary: Humanitarian relief agency delivering disaster response, medical aid, shelter, water and education to people in need in Malaysia and abroad.
beneficiaries: Disaster- and conflict-affected communities in Malaysia and countries including Palestine, Sudan, Somalia, Yemen, Lebanon and Myanmar
